transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have a customer order for 1800 cartons of the new 750-milliliter format due by Monday morning, and Line 6 is available for a Saturday shift. Before I can authorize production, I need to go through our normal Saturday startup review. I'd like to hear from each of you on quality, maintenance, and safety conditions related to running this new format on Line 6. Please report any findings formally so we can get them on the record. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to formally report my quality findings. My review of the new-format trial paperwork, which I completed yesterday, found that the first production run requires a 30-minute first-article approval and 100% inspection of the first 200 cartons. I should note that the paperwork is currently still in quality's unfiled trial folder, so we'll need to make sure it's properly filed as part of this process.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Thanks, Evan. I'll formally report my maintenance findings now. I received the installed servo controller's latest firmware record from the vendor this morning, and it confirms two critical items for the new 750-milliliter format on Line 6. First, the new format must run at exactly 90 cartons per minute or slower — exceeding that speed would risk a controller fault. Second, the format changeover requires a full 2 hours of mechanical setup. I should note for the record that the maintenance work order for this setup has not yet been opened, so we'll need to get that created and assigned before any setup work begins.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to formally report my safety findings from yesterday's walkdown. The new-format guide adjustment on Line 6 requires two trained employees during setup, and a marked 1.5-meter exclusion zone must be established around the infeed. I documented this finding during the walkdown, but I want to note for the record that the Saturday startup board has not yet been updated with this information.
transcript.speaker: A4
